# GH-300 Lab Quality Checklist

- Exercise maps to one GH-300 objective.
- Estimated time is 10-20 minutes.
- Total steps do not exceed 12.
- One primary interaction surface is selected.
- Every task includes validation.
- Troubleshooting entries include symptom and exact fix.
- Cleanup fully reverses lab changes.
- References include current Microsoft Learn URLs.
- Wording is concise and non-ambiguous.
- Scenario company is randomized when used.
